# BuzzyBrains Academy

> BuzzyBrains Academy is a coaching institute in Pune, India, offering IIT-JEE, NEET, Olympiad, Foundation (Grades 6-10), and international-board (IGCSE/IB/AP/SAT) preparation. Batches are capped at 12 students, taught by IITian and IIM-alumni faculty, with AI-powered learning tools. Founded on 25+ years of combined teaching experience.

Key facts: batches capped at 12 students; faculty are IIT/IIM alumni; centres in Amanora and Kharadi, Pune; phone +91-98505-70525; email hello@buzzybrainsacademy.com.

## Programs

- [Foundation Program (Grades 6-10)](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/foundation): conceptual groundwork in Maths and Science before board/competitive exams.
- [IIT-JEE Coaching](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/12th-board-pcm): JEE Main and Advanced preparation for Grade 11-12 PCM students and droppers.
- [NEET Coaching](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/12th-board-pcb): NEET preparation for Grade 11-12 PCB students.
- [Board Exam Test Series](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/test-series): CBSE/ICSE Grade 10 & 12 mock exam series with examiner-style evaluation.
- [Olympiad Coaching](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/olympiads): Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology and coding olympiads (IOQM, SOF, NMTC, AMC, Math Kangaroo).
- [Commerce Tuitions](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/commerce-tuitions): Class 11-12 Commerce, plus CUET and CA Foundation coaching.
- [International Boards](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/international-boards): IGCSE, IB and AP exam coaching.
- [Code Ninja](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/coding-lab) and [Programming Classes](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/programming-classes): coding, AI foundations and computational logic for Grades 6-12.
- [One-on-One Coaching](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/one-on-one): personalized 1-on-1 mentoring across all subjects.
- [Ivy League Counselling](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/ivy-league-counselling): US university application and profile-building guidance.
- [Board Exam Study Planner](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/board-exam-study-planner): free printable study planner for CBSE/ICSE/SSC Class 10 & 12.
